fields.name: Query descriptor
fields.description: Query carries the SQL text, logical name, parameter-name sequence, and command type that define its provider-neutral query representation.

members.name: Sql
members.description: SQL text supplied when the Query is constructed.

members.name: Name
members.description: Logical name supplied when the Query is constructed.

members.name: ParameterNames
members.description: Parameter-name sequence supplied when the Query is constructed.

members.name: Type
members.description: System.Data command kind supplied by a derived Query type.

representations.CSharp: abstract Query exposes string Sql, string Name, string[] ParameterNames, and abstract System.Data.CommandType Type.
